ui.appointment_effect_chancellor.zhHant: 提供內政及勢力決策建言。
ui.appointment_effect_chancellor.en: Provides civil administration and faction advice.

ui.appointment_effect_governor.zhHant: 負責城市月計畫；可依授權安排內政。
ui.appointment_effect_governor.en: Handles the city monthly plan and authorized administration.

ui.appointment_summary_grand_general.zhHant: 對部隊傷害 +3%；受部隊傷害 -3%

ui.appointment_summary_strategist.zhHant: 混亂、滅火 +5 個百分點；上限 90%

ui.appointment_summary_chief.zhHant: 混亂、滅火本人 +8、同場 +3 個百分點；不疊加
ui.appointment_summary_chief.en: Confusion and extinguish: own +8, allies +3; no stacking

ui.appointment_explanation.zhHant: 任命職位由君主指派；武將身分不會因此改變。
ui.appointment_explanation.en: Appointments are assigned by the ruler and do not change an officer's identity.

ui.military_appointment_replace_confirm.zhHant: 現任者：{0}；所選武將原軍職：{1}。再次按確認職位將解除相關舊職並任命。
ui.military_appointment_replace_confirm.en: Current holder: {0}; selected officer's previous military post: {1}. Press Assign again to replace them.

ui.military_effect_grand_general.zhHant: 所率部隊：攻擊傷害 +3%，受到的部隊傷害 -3%。
ui.military_effect_grand_general.en: Own unit: damage dealt +3%; troop damage received -3%.

ui.military_effect_rear_general.zhHant: 所率部隊：受到的部隊傷害 -5%。

ui.strategist_effect.zhHant: 所率部隊：混亂及滅火成功率 +5 個百分點，上限 90%。
ui.strategist_effect.en: Own unit: confusion and extinguish success +5 percentage points, capped at 90%.

ui.chief_strategist_effect.zhHant: 本人部隊混亂及滅火成功率 +8；在場時其他同勢力武將部隊 +3 個百分點，與軍師加成取較高值，上限 90%。
ui.chief_strategist_effect.en: Own unit: confusion and extinguish success +8 points. While present, other officers of the same faction gain +3; strategist bonuses do not stack. Cap: 90%.

ui.appointment_replace_confirm.zhHant: 現任者：{0}；所選武將將解除的職位：{1}。再次按確認職位將解除相關舊職並任命。
ui.appointment_replace_confirm.en: Current holder: {0}; selected officer's post to remove: {1}. Press Assign again to confirm.
